114891.overview: Super Mario Bros. Crossover is a fan-made crossover platform Flash video game launched on Newgrounds on April 27, 2010 by Exploding Rabbit. It is based mostly on the gameplay of Nintendo's Super Mario Bros. for the NES. The only major difference is the ability to control characters that debuted in other Nintendo Entertainment System games unrelated to the Mario series, plus the ability to use "skins" of levels and characters from other games and platforms. The latest version available (3.1.21) was released on December 27, 2013.

118338.overview: Super Mario 63 is a fan-game inspired by Nintendo's Super Mario 64. Many levels and features are based upon it and other of Nintendo's games, but a variety of them are completely original. Among them include a detailed storyline, ability to play as Luigi, a highly customizable Level Designer with sharable codes, three different FLUDD Power-ups, four different power-caps, and 64 Shine Sprites & 64 Star Coins to collect.

118339.overview: Super Smash Flash, commonly abbreviated SSF or SSF1, is an non-profit Flash fan game developed by Cleod9 Productions and published by McLeodGaming. The game is based on Super Smash Bros. Melee in the menu format, music, and numerous other fields such as game play modes. The game features several characters from the Super Smash Bros. series, such as Mario, Samus, Link, Kirby, and Pikachu. It also features many third-party characters, including Sonic (who, at the time of the game's creation, was not confirmed to be a character in Super Smash Bros. Brawl) and Mega Man X. Besides that, it also includes original fan characters like Blade.

118457.overview:
Samorost is a puzzle point-and-click adventure game developed by Amanita Design. The first game of the Samorost series, it was released in 2003 for free at the Amanita Design website.

The player interacts with the world with simple point and click interface directing a small, white-clad humanoid with a little cap and brown boots (called simply "gnome" by Dvorsky). The goal of the Samorost games is to solve a series of puzzles and brain teasers. The puzzles are sequentially linked forming an adventure story. The game contains no inventory or dialogue, and the solving of puzzles mainly consists of clicking onscreen elements in the correct order. Solving a puzzle will immediately transport the player character to the next screen.

135859.overview:
Superfighters is all about little men shooting, stabbing, mashing, smashing, burning and blowing each other into tiny bits... and then doing it all over again!

The first thing you need to know about SF is this: IT AIN'T FAIR. It's not supposed to be fair. Player spawns are random. Weapon spawns are random. The objects that spawn on the map are random. Critical hits with guns are random. It's not about balanced competetive gameplay, it's about chaos. Complete and utter chaos. We ask that you keep that in mind and don't get angry if you have a bad first experience - the tables will turn.

144218.overview: Welcome to the island where your new adventures begin! Play minigames, buy clothes, decorate your igloo, adopt puffles, become a ninja or secret agent. And much more! And completely free!

150710.overview: This game takes place directly where the movie left off: Big Blue cowering in front of his MARV truck and the entire population of Slusher Tower and Wing were ready to give his face a serious - and extremely painful - makeover. Running out of reasonable options, Big Blue desperately looks around his shoulders and sees a welcome sight: right behind the bushes. A few Blues who are armed with various traps have survived the retaliation are waiting for Big Blue's instructions. No longer afraid, Big Blue's terrified expression becomes replaced by a smirk, confusing the Defenders. Abruptly, the cause for the sudden transformation becomes apparent, as all the fighters (Except Stedro, Marcstick, Stickhanh, Westick, Stickyle, Stick Matt and Standrew) are ensnared by various traps of the surviving Blues. Infuriated, Standrew, delivers a massive kick to Big Blue, who, despite the fact that he was initially going to run, views this as no more than a minor setback, cackling into the distance as he relished the thought of having finally succeeding in defeating the mighty Slushers. However, Standrew had other ideas. He sends the remaining fighters into the air, intent on giving Big Blue one big boo boo.

156487.overview:
Quick arcade style shooter game where the objective is to knock down a multitude of children in a snowball fight.

This is the original snowball fight game that was first published in the late 90’s. Since then SnowCraft has traveled the globe reaching an estimated 30  million players.  Log files over the past few years show that people in more than 200 countries continue to play every year, making it one of the most widely known and popular games on the Web.

SnowCraft was first published by Nicholson NY in 1998 as a holiday greeting to a few friends and clients. After launch, it spread virally until at last count it had reached over 30 million players around the globe.

164780.overview:
Shell Shockers is an egg-cellent laugh and whoever came up with this free online .io game must be a cracking good game developer. Become an Egg. Wield a shotgun, sniper rifle or shotgun and blast other eggs to smithereens in this 3D First Person Shooter game. The game doesn’t run amazingly well, there are problems with latency and hitboxes, but the entire concept is hilarious and you can easily spend hours playing this game. Watch as eggs burst into a tasty-looking dollop on the floor after your eradicate them with a well-placed shotgun slug between their eggy eyes.

We wouldn’t call Shell Shockers as competitive as Krunker.io, one of the main competitors for .io FPS games, but there is a charm to the mechanics of this online game. The map design is also pretty good with multiple levels and platforms for dynamic gameplay. You can collect points and build streaks to unlock Golden Eggs, which reward you with skins and other unlockables. We’ve never been too successful in FPS game – the game is difficult to master, especially in regards to understanding gun mechanics. If you put some time into the game we think it would be a pretty competitive experience.

167853.overview:
Smashers.io is a strategy io game where your goal is to grow your hammer to defeat your enemies.

Clown Games presents a brand new and unique game: Target and smash your enemies, collect the dots and grow your hammer. Show no mercy to the worms around to grow faster.

168007.overview: Slither.io is free for all battle arena type game and definitely one of the more popular io games around currently; here you play as a snake in  an agar.io like world and try to gain size whilst taking out other player-controlled snakes. Around the map are tons of small food orbs to collect which will slowly but surely increase your snakes size, you can also gain size quicker by consuming an enemy snake. The objective of this game is ultimately survival but some of the more competitive snakes also aim to be the biggest and baddest mother trucker out there by reaching a top spot on the leader board.

172895.overview:
A 2D pixel-art fighting game featuring 8 of the greatest scientists in history

You got to choose 8 scientists to fight with each other. Albert Einstein, Charles Darwin, Isaac Newton, Marie Curie, Alan Turing, Pythagoras, Nikola Tesla and Stephen Hawking. Each one of them have a special move based on their real life legacy.

181889.overview: As the story continues, Henry watches a video clip of the news on his television showing the mayor announcing the open Tunis Diamonds exhibit. Since the Tunisian diamond is worth up to $ 12 million, Henry quickly decides to steal the diamond. He is seen removing the keys from the table and heads to the Museum.

216050.overview: A Super Smash Bros. fan game developed by x2i, featuring Sonic characters.

219221.overview:
Stick RPG is a life simulation RPG where you play as a blue stick figure. Create a character with random stats, and then explore the world. The possibilities are limitless; go to work, get an education, do drugs, and much more.

According to the game's "Instructions" menu, the player has fallen asleep and woken up in the 2nd dimension.

219227.overview: Learn how to conduct yourself in social situations with Social Interaction Trainer.

419348.overview: Sudoku made for the journalistic website "O Globo".

419381.overview: Super Mario Maker World Engine is an incredible fan game which faithfully recreates the popular Nintendo video game Super Mario Maker, the game was created by YouTube user Franyer Farías. Create your own levels, save them and share them with your friends, use all the tools available to create the craziest level and give it the appearance of your favorite Super Mario, you can choose between Super Mario Bros 1, 3, World and U, play as Mario , Luigi, Toad or Toadette.

420011.overview:
It’s a beautiful morning in Bikini Bottom. But something’s wrong. That would seem like a normal thing, especially with SpongeBob but this time, it isn’t a joke. Gary is missing and you have no idea what has happened to him.
You learn that it was the terrible tyrant, PigSaw, who has kidnapped Gary. But he isn’t just holding him hostage. No, he plans to fry Gary, unless of course, SpongeBob can do what he is asked of in the action packed Spongebob Saw Game. Hurry! The clock is ticking.
The objective of the game is to perform the tasks as directed by your friends so you can make it to PigSaw’s place as fast as possible and rescue Gary. Collect as many artifacts as you can at every level as you’re going to need them sooner or later.

422915.overview: What happens when you mix SUPER HOT with Hotline Miami ? You get SUPERHOTline Miami ! Time moves only when you move, but this time, from a top down perspective and with some extra violence. This is an upgraded version of the original SUPERHOTline Miami, it features many improvements used by its sequel SHOOTOUT Inc (The full game based on SUPERHOTline Miami), such as improved bullet hit detection, better hitboxes, AI reworks, new sprites and animations etc.

423023.overview:
SuperHot is an excellent FPS game where time only moves when you move. This unique concept gives SuperHot suspense and action like no other game. Jump in and shatter the enemies!

The SuperHot web game is a free-to-play prototype designed as a demo for the full game. The series now includes SuperHot: VR and SuperHot: Mind Control Delete.

Controls:
WASD or arrow keys to move.
LMB to shoot.
RMB to throw a gun.
Space bar to jump.

451331.overview:
This game borrows the assumptions of the platform genre that Lab 14 engaged generally and brings them home specifically, to run-and-jumper ground zero with an environment that uncannily echoes the game that broke the genre, Super Mario Bros 1. There are unimportant distinctions -- for whatever reason, plumber Mario seems to have been replaced by a white bipedal cat-creature, and the enemies are various species of white cloudlike ovals... but like in SMB1, it is not their devious AI that will be causing the player problems. Instead, it is the very geography of the playfield that trips up the player -- lulling us into a false sense of security with a backdrop that's played before us thousands of times, it savagely wrenches things into a skewed nightmare Mushroom Kingdom more akin to movies of "unplayable" ROM hacks than to any gameplay from our actual experience. The very laws of physics we have learned and internalized strike against us -- solid ground falls away unexpectedly; pipes fatally launch us into the sky; platforms unhinge and crush us by surprise; the very flagpoles marking the ends of levels duck and weave out of the way or, worse, shoot suppressing cover fire, as jarring and final as the squishing foot in Terry Gilliam's Monty Python animation. The star of invincibility is fatal to the touch. The only way to feel out where the environment will betray the player is to be let down by its apparent safety, over and over again.

There are four levels, modeled with sadistic fidelity after the four areas of SMB world 1, periodically studded with necessary half-time savepoints. Despite its intentional brutality, however, the game can be finished, and for those who found the too-tough-to-be-released-in-the-West Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels a cakewalk, this might satisfy their hunger for senseless failure.

451366.overview:
Sands of the Coliseum is a turn-based fighting Flash game developed by Berzerk Studio.

In this turn-based game, the player will command their own army of gladiators and win fights against specialized warriors. The player can visit the coliseum to fight and train their gladiators against other players. In the shop, they can equip their fighter with more powerful weapons and clothings to improve their defence against enemies. New gladiators can be bought on the slave market and sent into the arena to win battle after battle for their team. The player can also access Syracuse, Rome, Athena and other major cities and make their way to world domination.

451367.overview: The Sea Has No Claim is a game by Lucas Pope, who also made Return of the Obra Dinn and Papers Please.

451368.overview: Spider: Downloaded is an action platformer game by Sakupen that was released on newgrounds on November 13, 2015. In this game, a spider gets downloaded by a malicious computer. Using his web to swing through obstacles, the spider must find his way out of the digital prison and free the other prisoners.

451369.overview: Soundodger is a Web Game created in Adobe Flash and playable on the Adult Swim Games website. Created by Studio Bean, the game place you in the role of a small, featureless circular cursor controlled by moving the mouse pointer. Your goal is to avoid several bullets that come into the circular playing field from the outside which are fired on beat with the music.

451370.overview: This game revolves around the tale of a young boy as he journeys through his twisted dreamscape to help his dead sister cross over to the afterlife. On his journey, he must avoid dangerous traps, vengeful spirits, and the eldritch nature of the dream world itself.

451371.overview:
In the kingdom of Fredericus lived a famed dragon hunter. He was beloved by many and feared by his enemies, as he brought justice and peace wherever he traveled... but this story is about his brother.

Reemus, the insect exterminator and his sidekick, Liam, the purple bear travel the land in pursuit of creating a legacy of their own. An opportunity arises, as a tavern is pillaged by a horde of ants, so Reemus and Liam set out to kill the ant queen responsible for the infestation.

The game is a point-and-click adventure game, where the player has to click on certain objects in the environment triggering certain events, click on Reemus for relevant actions, and click on Liam for hints. Some events are timed, so they have to be triggered at the right time, in order to succeed, else it will end with the death of Reemus. Depending on the way the last scene is handled, multiple endings are possible.

451373.overview:
Sierra 7 (original) is a first-person shooter Flash game developed by Simon Hason and published by SHD Games on Armor Games on January 5, 2011.

This game pinpoints a world-wide war between private militia companies out for government-targeted violence & carnage. The player of this game is the 7th special operative in the Unit "Sierra" which is tasked to neutralize the militia forces with their superior skills & tactics.

451374.overview: A little game with vinnie the bounty hunter.

451375.overview: Super Crazy Guitar Maniac Deluxe is a series of flash games by Shinki. The games are similar to Guitar Hero in term of gameplay. The player must press the correct key when i reaches to the center without breaking the combo.

451376.overview:
Stick Cricket is a cricket flash game that was developed by Colin Rowe and released in December 2003.

In Stick Cricket, the player controls the batsman of an English cricket team who is facing off against other international teams in a cricket championship. When the player starts a match, the bowler of the opposing team with throw the ball towards the player who must hit it as well as they can to prevent any of the opposition from catching it. The player hit the ball in a variety of methods and directions using various keys and should adapt depending on where the bowler throws the ball.

Once the batsman has been bowled out, the next member of the team will become the batsman and the cycle repeats until the game is over. If the player wins a match, they will progress onto the next match against a new team and be given a password that they can enter in the menu in order to return to their position in the tournament after exiting the game.

451377.overview:
Slacker is a Flash game developed by TikiLoungeGod (real name Sam Cook) and published on Newgrounds on May 4, 2003.

In this game, the player will click on things and Slacky the Slacker, the protagonist of this game, will pick it up or respond with a witty comment. Once the item is on the inventory, the player will have to click on a star icon with an "S" on it and they will see their inventory screen. On the inventory screen, the player will have to click on the "Use" or "Combine" button and then on the item(s) they want to use. They can scroll over with the "+" button for a description of the item.

451378.overview: Can you make the right choices to survive undead apocalypse?

451379.overview:
Fight off the horde in the awesome sequel to SAS2. This time more maps, more guns, more ranks and…MORE PLAYERS!
That’s right, this time 4 player co-op multiplayer is here for your zombie shooting delight. You are not alone.

451380.overview: Storyteller is the third game in the Moon Stories trilogy of prototype games. The screen is divided in three vignettes that tell a different part of a single story ("Once Upon a Time", "When They Grew Up", "The End"). It features two boys and girl. They can be dragged and dropped with the mouse in each vignette to change their role and alter the story. Changes are immediately visible and they can turn around the storyline completely. This leads to many different situations and endings. Unlike the first two games, the game mechanic of photographing elements to alter the environment is not used here.

451381.overview: SmileysWar, or Smileys War, is a 2D action shooting war Flash game, which features modes, single-player challenges, 10 different weapons, fast-paced shooting action, the ability to create the map and character, and more. The player has to shoot down your enemies, earn XP points and unlock new content.

451382.overview: A conspiracy by the organization Globex, threatens the civilized world with biochemical weapons, with only the titular Strike Force to oppose them. In this platformer, the player plays a soldier with one of different classes: Medic, Assassin, Commando and Tank. Each class has its own stats and choice of weaponry. The game can be player in Campaign Mode with 15 missions or Challenge Mode with small missions. As missions are completed in the Campaign Mode, the soldier levels up and any cash earned can be used to purchase other weapons.

451383.overview: Scene of the Crime is a short point-and-click adventure game, in which the player is a detective investigating a murder crime scene. He has to collect evidence on the only location the game features, a motel room. By combining the evidence inside the player's inventory, the case can be solved.

451387.overview:
Simian.interface is an abstract developed and published by vested interest.

The gameplay revolves around an abstract puzzle experience for simian participants of all ages and abilities. There are no explicit rules, no instructions, and very simple controls. Puzzles must be solved using pattern recognition, intuition, and experimentation.

451389.overview: An anthropomorphized mechanical spike trap, akin to Super Mario 3's Thwomp, waits attached to a dungeon ceiling for platforming heroes to wander by underneath and get messily pulped. The spike trap's humdrum and limited existence is controlled by the player, and specifically the player's space bar only. The only question -- to drop or not to drop? -- is refined a bit by demanding precise timing. The room in which the spike trap is installed periodically manifests new fixtures of video game set dressing (teleporters, conveyor belts) to change the heroes' approach, and sometimes the square-jawed little protagonists take advantage of various platformer power-ups to break up the monotony of the old mind game of wondering whether they'll make a run for it or not. Drop too soon and the alarmed hero will take off during the trap's brief refractory period.

451390.overview:
Sports Heads: Tennis is a sports game.

In this 2-player tennis tournament you have to maneuver your racy sports head over the court. Time your jumps well and swing the bat to hit the ball as you also can aim for different power-ups, which will affect the tennis ball's physics in different ways.

451391.overview:
SteamBirds is a turn-based aircraft combat game set in an alternative XX century with a light steampunk flavour.

The scene is commanded from a top-down perspective and all aircraft are implicitly at the same altitude. The missions always start out with the player outnumbered or at least with inferior firepower. Units on both sides are equipped with at most two special abilities such as 180 or 360 degree quick-turns, double speed, armour at the expense of firepower etc. Although special abilities can be used an unlimited number of times, a turn with no ability must alternate after turns with abilities in use.

Not only the health bar shrinks when an aircraft gets shot. Rudders cannot steer left, right, or at all, guns get jammed for a turn etc. Missions end with the complete destruction of either side.

451392.overview:
Steamshovel Harry is a joke Flash game originally created for E4.com with musical production by Brad Sucks. It turns out to be a tutorial that goes on for too long, as the background music slowly becomes more pervasive the unnecessarily heartfelt, so you want the sound when you play through this if you’re going to attempt to endure the whole thing.

The strangely haunting full length theme to Steamshovel Harry can be found here, and the Planetary Anthem of Earth can be found here. I wrote the lyrics and Brad of Brad Sucks did an amazing job performing and composing the music.

451393.overview:
Steppenwolf: The X-Creatures Project is a 2001 episodic action-adventure video game developed by Sarbakan and published by Warner Bros.

Where the story follows Intrepid Reporter Meg Crimson as she travels the world documenting the existence of near-mythical creatures. On her first assignment in the heart of Africa, her boss advises her to find a scientist named Alan Kane, an expert on cryptozoology who went off the grid years ago and now lives as hermit known as the Steppenwolf.

Not all is as it seems though, and it soon becomes clear that Meg and Steppenwolf are pawns in an international conspiracy centered on the X-Creatures Project: a failed scientific experiment based on using the DNA of cryptids to create a serum capable of granting humans immortality….

451394.overview:
Step into the high-pressure world of covert operations with Stick Squad, where you’ll assume the role of a skilled sniper tasked with taking down criminals and terrorists across the globe. With its captivating storyline and challenging missions, Stick Squad delivers an adrenaline-fueled experience that will test your precision, strategy, and quick thinking at every turn.

As a member of an elite sniper team, you’ll face a variety of high-stakes missions, each presenting its own unique set of challenges. From urban environments to remote wilderness, no target is out of reach for your sharpshooting skills.

Gameplay in Stick Squad is both simple and skillful. Using your mouse, you’ll maneuver your sniper scope to line up your shots with precision. Every click of the mouse triggers a shot, so accuracy is paramount. And with each mission presenting different objectives, you’ll need to stay focused and adapt your strategy to the task at hand.

Starting with a standard sniper rifle, you’ll need to carefully manage your shots, as reloading after every bullet leaves little room for error. Miss a shot, and your target might flee, forcing you to restart the mission. Additionally, careful planning is essential, especially when dealing with multiple targets in close proximity.

As you progress through missions and achieve success, you’ll earn in-game currency that can be used to upgrade your arsenal. Visit the shop to enhance your rifle’s stability, speed, and capacity, or invest in new weapons like assault rifles and handguns for added firepower.

With its blend of gripping gameplay, challenging missions, and strategic upgrades, Stick Squad offers an immersive sniper experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat as you navigate the dangerous world of covert operations. Are you ready to take aim and join the squad?

451395.overview:
Stick War is a Real Time Strategy flash game made by Jason Whitham, Brock White, and other people.

You play as the nation, Order Empire. The other nations inhabiting the land of Inamorta, struggle for dominance among a war-hungry society. After constant military harassment from the surrounding nations, you take action by commencing a conquest against the other nations, and no one will survive (Except you).

451397.overview:
Straw Hat Samurai is a very gory action samurai game.

It is a time of war, the lands are torn between conquering warlords. The Aka-Ryu army from the north is attempting to expand southwards and you have to defend your forts that have come under seige!

451398.overview:
The foxes have kidnapped the kitty princes. Run, brave kitties! Reach King Fox and save the damsel!

StrikeForce Kitty is a cute platform game of auto-run variety (i.e. the screen moves automatically and the player has only limited control over the actions of the characters) and also a dress-up collectathon. The player controls a team of four kitties who run through stages fighting evil foxes. They can jump or drop from ledges, but all the rest, including fighting is automated. Each kitty and enemy fox has three parameters: health, attack and speed (including the speed of the attacks). When the fight begins the adversaries exchange hits and whoever deals the most damage and stays alive, wins. Defeated foxes drop gear which adds to the above three parameters when equipped. The gear includes hats, coats, guns, swords etc., many of these coming from popular franchises like Wolverine's trademark claws from the X-Men, lightsabers from Star Wars etc., also including some rather obscure for a cute kitty game references like Tarantino's Pulp Fiction. Some gear is grouped in sets, giving kitties special abilities when equipped.The gear can also be found in chests which are unlocked with keys found in the stages. By collecting fish the kitties also gain levels and the player may distribute points between the three parameters.

451399.overview:
Sugar, Sugar is a puzzle game where, on each level, the player has to get the grains from a falling stream of sugar into cups in order to fill them. The falling sugar obeys the usual laws of gravity; the player's role is drawing lines to create slopes, over which the sugar will slide down into the cups. Already drawn lines cannot be erased. Each cup must have 100 grains fall into it before it is considered full.

The levels are wraparound; sugar which falls off the bottom (or top, in reverse gravity) of the screen reappears from a corresponsing hole at the other side. Some levels mix things up by introducing colored cups; in order for the falling sugar to fill it, it must first be redirected through colored filters (some levels also have striped cups, which must be filled half with one color and half with another). On some levels, there is a button which can be clicked at any time to reverse gravity.

451400.overview:
The Super Exciting Adventures of Kit & The Octopod is a game published on November 8, 2011.

A little octopus is in a big grief. The girl of his dreams was stolen from him by a Bad Mood Bear.

451401.overview:
Super Press Space To Win is an action RPG Flash game produced by Rhete with voice acting from D-Mac-Double. It was published on Newgrounds on May 19, 2009.

Features:
-Dynamic Real Time Combat - Jump, slash, and block enemy attacks
-Upgradeable Stats - Personalize your character any way you want
-Magic spells - Unlease power elemental forces to lay waste to your foes
-Shops to purchase additional items and gear to help your quest
-Three diabolical bosses to really test your skills
-Dramatic cinemas with full voice acting by industry profesionals
-11 dramatic orchestral tunes from the fine folks over at the audio portal

451402.overview: In Super Stacker the player has to stack blocks of different shapes and sizes upon each other, starting from one or more pre-placed blocks. Since the order of the blocks is fixed, he has to think ahead. A level is lost when one of the blocks falls and touches the bottom of the playfield. The game contains twelve levels in total.

451403.overview:
Challenging single-player strategy game about insectoid alien monsters trying to murder each other.

Each of your minions has its own AI, controlling its behavior on the pseudo-3D battlefield. Mutate your eggs, spawn your swarm, spit some goop, and watch the chaos of battle!

Each of the 21 levels unlocks something new to play with, and if you complete them all, you can test yourself with a few “challenge levels”.

451404.overview:
Remember , gladiator, when you were but a young novice? Go back and relive the glory in the classic gladiatorial game , the original Swords and Sandals. The idea is as follows...

Features:
-Create your gladiator
-Choose your weapons and armour
-Fight
-Earn gold
-Fight again, and again, and again!

451406.overview: Synopsis Quest is an adventure Flash game developed by Skipmore.

451407.overview:
Scary Maze Game is a horror maze flash game that was developed by Jeremy Winterrowd and released in 2003.

Scary Maze Game likely needs little introduction due to the extreme amount of popularity it gained in the late 2000s and early 2010s. On the surface it appears to be a simple maze game in which the player must navigate their cursor from one size of the screen to the other while sticking to the coloured path and not touching the black edges. Whilst the first two levels are fairly simple with wider paths, the difficulty is ramped up in the third level, forcing the player to move closer to their screen in order to better move their cursor through the very narrow path.

It is on this third level that they player will be shocked with a jumpscare, featuring a loud screaming sound and an image of Regan MacNeil from The Exorcist movie. Many players of this game who experienced the jumpscare would prank their friends by asking them to play the game without warning them about the jumpsacre and waiting to see their reaction. Numerous recordings of people’s reactions to the game were uploaded to YouTube, some of which receiving millions of views. This game is remembered by many who grew up in the 2000s and played it due to how much the jumpscare shocked them.

451410.overview: Small Worlds is an atmospheric platformer about exploring five different maps by jumping and falling to reach new areas. Initially, only a very small portion of each area is visible, but the player's field of view will expand as they explore. The first map is a hub world that connects to the other four through teleporters. Once the player has entered a new map, they will not be able to get back to the hub area until they find a glowing sphere in a distant corner of the current map. However, each non-hub map may only be visited once, and it is possible to leave an area before fully exploring it. The game ends once all maps have been visited and the player returns to the hub.

451411.overview: Snailiad is an 8-bit-inspired game, which uses the NES palette most of the time, and uses NES music I wrote using Famitracker. I hope you enjoy it! :-) There's some references to eight-bit classihelped inspire Snailiad, and you might also find a cameo or two from RPG Shooter: Starwish, if you play long enough.

451412.overview: A fast-paced, streamlined RTS where quick thinking and aggressive moves are rewarded. Colonize worlds, build ships, destroy fleets, and discover lost alien space stations on your journey through the stars.

451413.overview: Solipskier is a fast-paced action game based around skiing. The aim of the game is to get the skier as far as possible without crashing and rack up a large amount of points, but the player does not control him directly. Instead you need to draw the snow for him to ski on, with the mouse (Browser) of by touching the screen (iPhone). Downslopes allow him to speed up, but he will climb up hills as well. By drawing downslopes ending in an upwards curve, he can be launched in the air. Doing that in quick succession allows him to travel great distances at large speeds. While in the air tricks are performed automatically when the player stops painting snow. The game builds up a score while playing, and by catching air, stars are earned and multipliers are built up. It is also possible to ski through gates and long tunnels to receive additional points and gain speed. Touching red gates kills the skier instantly, however and there are parts that prevent the player from drawing snow to ski on. Indicators on the right announce gates, tunnels and hazards. The skier is designed as a white figure with headphones, blasting rock music. At very high speeds it is possible to lose the headphones, making the rushing wind the only sound.

451414.overview: Sonny is a zombified survivor, who is accompanied by Louis the Blind in a battle against the overlord zombie Baron Brixius. The player chooses one of four classes each with its own special skills, strengths and weaknesses. The gameplay consists of RPG-based battles in which the player can perform an offensive or defensive action each turn. Killing enemies earns money and experience, which when accumulated allows the player to bolster personal attributes and buy equipment to improve Sonny's chances of beating tougher opponents.

451415.overview:
Spec Ops: War on Terrorism is a first person shooter flash game developed by Thorsten and released on December 27, 2001.

In Spec Ops: War on Terrorism, the player takes control of a soldier who is fighting terrorists and must complete four unique missions. In these missions, the player is armed with three weapons; an M4A1 is the player’s primary weapon, which has 30 bullets per magazine and can be switched to by pressing the 1 key. The player’s secondary weapon is an M9 9mm pistol which holds 15 rounds per clip and can be switched to in a pinch. The third weapon in the game that the player has in their arsenal is an M40A1 sniper rifle which can only be used in the second mission, where the player will have to take wind into account in order to use it effectively.

In the first mission of the game, the player attacks a camp full of enemy soldiers and must eliminate them all as they run out of their tents to attack. In the second level, the player has entered a cave and must ambush a group of enemies who are initially facing away from them, some of whom will take cover once fired upon. The third mission allows the player to use the sniper rifle from a vantage point, where they must snipe all enemy soldiers without raising the alarm. In the final mission, the player reaches Bin Laden and can rough him up a bit before he is handed over for capture.

451416.overview:
You feel gentle a thump as you land in the warm tropical sand. Who are you? Who do you want to be? Something in your heart whispers of shade, majesty, and acorns. What does this mean?

Your mother waves to the east. On the far side of the ocean is a world! Plants and animals! Mountains and valleys! Birds and flowers and a forest of mighty oaks. Yes! You know that this is who and what you are meant to be: an oak.

Your parents can't teach you how to be an oak. The only one who can teach you how to be an oak is another oak. Still, your parents teach you what they can - the way of the coconut. This will give you the ability to cross to the mainland, and be one step closer to your goal. It's not much, but it's a start!

In Sprout, you will embark on a casual, botanical-puzzle-adventure. You will make friends, learn new skills, solve puzzles, and ultimately become the mighty oak that you were always meant to be.

451417.overview: Storm the House 3 is a shooter game developed by Ivory. It is the sequel to Storm the House 2 where you shoot down waves of enemies trying to destroy your base. The player has to defend the base on the right side of the map from the enemies on the left side of the map. Each wave takes the course of one day. At the end of each day, the player may repair the house, upgrade their walls, purchase more gunmen, and more.

451418.overview:
Scriball is a puzzle game.

In this game, the player uses the string to guide the ball.

451420.overview:
The Submachine series consists of ten games which develop the main storyline and four spin-offs. In the games the player explores a mysterious world full of collapsed structures and strange devices and has to find a way further or out.

The first game is closest to the simple "escape the room" genre and only introduces a small part of the story. The player explores a large basement, consisting of several rooms, and solves puzzles in order to find an exit.

451421.overview: The greatest launching game of all time is finally here! Shopping Cart Hero 3 is the newest game in everyone's favorite launch series! Your objective is simple; fling yourself as far as possible in a shopping cart! Run down the hill, jump in your cart then fly off the jump! Buy tons of upgrades along the way including dynamite and better wheels! How far can you get? Good luck!

451422.overview: A classic dating sim made 15 years ago.

451423.overview:
Super Energy Apocalypse Recycled is a strategy defense game by larsiusprime and published on Kongregate on January 21, 2009.

The world is in ruins. Rebuild your base with sustainable energy choices, then survive the hordes of mutant alien zombies.

451424.overview: A combat-driven RPG where you play as Sinjid the ninja. There are many items and skills to use on your way in reaching the Dark Portal, where you will find hard challenging bosses.

451425.overview:
Skull Kid, also known as the skullkid, is an action arcade flash game that was developed by chance and released on September 14, 2002.

Skull Kid is a relatively short flash game in which the player controls a character, presumably a kid, who is wearing a skull mask and is armed with a chainsaw. In the game, the player must make their way through an office building, killing anyone and destroying anything in their way. On the first floor of the building, the player will be met with little resistance from the office workers they are killing and must simply chainsaw through them in a brutal fashion along with any other furniture in their way until they reach the elevator on the other side of the room.

Once the player reaches the second floor, the gameplay is switched up dramatically and as is the difficulty. The player will now be armed with only a pistol, and they must make their way across another floor that is filled with office workers who are also armed with firearms. The player must take cover behind objects and engage in firefights with the office workers one at a time by carefully peaking out of cover and firing at the right time in order to kill the workers and take as little damage as possible. The last office worker on this floor is particularly difficult as he is armed with a fully automatic weapon.

When the player has made it to the end of the second floor, they will arrive at another elevator and can proceed to the third and final floor. The third floor is the easiest and fastest to clear and features only one office worker, who appears to be the boss, who will let you simply walk up to him and put a chainsaw through his stomach. Upon killing the boss, the player will be presented with a victory screen and the option to play the game again.

451426.overview: Swords and Souls is an RPG in which players go into battle as a Soul of their own design, through a series of 30 levels and 44 enemies. As the player's Soul trains and survives battles, they can learn new skills and buy new equipment on their way to the top of the Soul Town mountain. Other upgrades and items that can help the player's Soul are also available, as well as a home full of secrets and a museum to invest in. In addition, a series of 5 mini-games can help improve a Soul's stats.

451534.overview:
RPG Shooter: Starwish is a Web Game that is Exactly What It Says on the Tin — a Horizontal Scrolling Shooter with RPG Elements. It was made in Adobe Flash and released in 2011.

Specifically, the author describes it as "a unique blend of a shooter, RPG, visual novel and dating sim". A lot of the drive of the game is based upon the storyline, the character interaction, and the upgrades and level ups for the main "shooter" game, which is played during missions on various sites of interest on the current planet.

451737.overview: SAB Baseball is an English-language single-player baseball sports game developed by Steve A. Baker, made using Java, and published on fungame.pe.kr. It was released on February 1, 2015.

451746.overview: Slime Volleyball is a volleyball game that is normally played with two players (though if one player plays, then they will play the slime on the left). Players win points by making the ball land on their opponent's side of the court. The first player to six points wins. They can touch the ball as many times as you like, and they can win a point even if they don't serve. They can play against a friend, or challenge the five computer opponents in one player mode.

451771.overview:
A humorous, physics-based game in which the player, as novice surgeon Nigel Burke, is asked to perform very complex medical procedures like heart transplants or brain surgery. The game is deliberately hard to control, with the player having to manually handle movement, rotation, and every individual finger of the hand they have to perform the operation with. Further, in addition to common surgical instruments like scalpels or bone saws, there is also an array of very inappropriate tools such as pens or hammers. All tools have to be picked up and controlled manually, and inevitable blunders are commented on by the player's alter ego.

The main game mechanic revolves around the patients' blood loss. Careless actions can lead to blood spills, and injuring certain body parts with inappropriate instruments can lead to a continuous blood loss indicated in millilitres per second, which puts a time limit on the completion of the surgery. An operation is considered successful if the organ in question is roughly in the right position, and the player's performance is judged according to duration and blood loss. The surgery is only failed when the patient completely bleeds out. More difficult missions take place in a moving ambulance, where the physical effects make precise action even more difficult.

A September 2013 update added alien autopsy transplants. Set in a new environment, the player operates on the alien Gworb with different organs to remove in six operations.

457042.overview: The bone chilling horror series comes to Java in Splatterhouse by Namco. Control Rick as he travels through The West Mansion and try to survive the chaos that he encounters. Hack and slash Zombies, Bats, Demons, and other gruesome monsters trying to stop Rick from rescuing his girlfriend. Pickup weapons to help you throughout Rick's demonic journey. With multiple difficulty levels and different paths to choose from, the excitement never ends!

461192.overview: Super Mario Flash 3 (known as SMF3) is the successor (or a hack, really) of Super Mario Flash 2 developed by Hiro, and it’s the second sequel of Super Mario Flash. The game is mainly based on Super Mario Bros. 3 but it has more types of tilesets from different games (especially from Super Mario Bros., Super Mario Bros. 2 and Super Mario World, enemies (such dolphins), sprites (such as !-switch), and also has title screen music (the Super Mario All-Stars Super Mario Bros. 3 title screen music) and a new story.

461194.overview:
Super Mario Flash (also known and abbreviated as SMF1) is the first of two online games developed by Pouetpu and released on pouetpu.pbworks.com before the creation of Pouetpu-games site. Super Mario Flash is entirely based off of the Nintendo game "Super Mario Bros.", and also combines several features of different games such "Super Mario Bros. 3" and "Super Mario World".

The main feature of this game is that includes a level editor so the players could make their own levels and share it on the forum/site so other players could test them and rate them.

Super Mario Flash also includes two protagonists: Mario and Luigi.

Its successor is Super Mario Flash 2, an official game made few years later due to the success of the game.

461202.overview:
Super Mario Flash 2 (mostly known as SMF2) is the second and, for now, the last game developed by Pouetpu on Pouetpu-games site, being released in 2011. Super Mario Flash 2 was intended to be a sequel to its predecessor "Super Mario Flash". The game design is based on the "Super Mario World" game (made by Nintendo) with some little features from other Mario games.

SMF2 also includes more stuff than its predecessor, such as Auto-scrolls and Water mode levels.

The levels and map shown in "1 player game" are also new made by Pouetpu himself.

Like its predecessor, Super Mario Flash 2 also includes a level editor where players can make their own levels and share them on Pouetpu-games page.

466668.overview: So many games, your mouse may call a time out!

466669.overview: There's a cornucopia of great games in this Nicktoons collection! Play all 20!

466732.overview: Find SpongeBob's most-beloved mollusk in this truly WHACK-y game!

472104.overview: Guide Akahn to the source of a relentless evil in this action RPG. Destroy the 'Dark Gates' that spew these devils forth and collect powerful 'Rune Stones' along the way, combining them to create even more powerful spells.

479638.overview: Stick Run was an addictive multiplayer game where you play as a Stick Man, dodge other obstacles, and pass your friends. You can play multiplayer in real time with other players around the globe and trade in the marketplace with friends/other players.

482472.overview: A turn-based gladiator RPG about developing a fighter from early bouts to battles against arena champions. Spend rewards on equipment, improve abilities and choose the right tactics for each opponent.
